# Product Design Intelligence (PDI)

> Portable, multi-host AI agent skill suite and curated knowledge library for product discovery, UX research, interaction design, UX writing, design systems, UI prototyping, UX auditing, and developer handoff.

## Core Instructions & Contracts
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Primary agent operating rules and evidence labeling contract.
- [Task Router](workflows/route-task.md): Skill selection matrix, complexity levels (quick, standard, complex), and operating modes (solo, team, enterprise).
- [Output Contract](workflows/output-contract.md): Required structure for evidence tags, trade-offs, artifacts, and honest validation.
- [Machine Manifest](pdi-manifest.json): Complete JSON index of skills, hosts, and knowledge taxonomy.

## Agent Skills (`.agents/skills/`)
- [design-handoff](.agents/skills/design-handoff/SKILL.md): Create a multi-audience implementation handoff and product decision changelog from a design or prototype. Structured so AI coding agents, product designers, software engineers, and non-technical stakeholders can each read what they need without invented specifications.
- [design-system](.agents/skills/design-system/SKILL.md): Define and audit design tokens, existing UI kit adaptation (shadcn/ui, Nuxt UI, Apple HIG, Material 3, or Custom), component APIs, state matrices and system governance. Use when selecting, reusing, or standardizing UI tokens and component contracts; do not invent bespoke components when a standard UI kit primitive exists.
- [frontend-design](.agents/skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md): Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
- [interaction-design](.agents/skills/interaction-design/SKILL.md): Define information architecture (IA), user journeys, flows, state logic matrices, transitions and error recovery for a feature. Use for onboarding, forms, navigation structure, or task flows; do not use for visual-only styling with no behavior to define.
- [product-framing](.agents/skills/product-framing/SKILL.md): Frame ambiguous product requests into problems, goals, constraints, assumptions and success criteria. Use before solution design when the problem or scope is unclear; do not use for a narrowly specified copy edit.
- [ui-prototyping](.agents/skills/ui-prototyping/SKILL.md): Build or modify an executable interface prototype or UI implementation using the project's active UI kit and validated design foundations. Use when a user needs a working screen or interactive artifact; do not use for critique alone, invent custom components over an existing UI kit, or imply a prototype is production-ready.
- [ux-audit](.agents/skills/ux-audit/SKILL.md): Evaluate an existing interface for usability, hierarchy, interaction, consistency and accessibility evidence. Use for a critique or audit of supplied or inspectable experiences; do not use as a substitute for user research or to invent observations.
- [ux-research](.agents/skills/ux-research/SKILL.md): Plan user research, usability tests, interview guides and synthesize supplied research notes or transcripts into tagged evidence. Use when planning discovery or synthesizing supplied observations; do not use to invent participant quotes or replace real user research.
- [ux-writing](.agents/skills/ux-writing/SKILL.md): Write and audit product interface copy, microcopy, empty states, onboarding prompts, action labels and error recovery messages. Use when crafting or reviewing UI text and terminology; do not use for long-form marketing articles or to promise unimplemented backend actions.
